setup: Door anchor at the top of the door. Clip the tube(s) to it, with the Pilates bar (wide grip) or two handles.
Kneel or stand facing the door, far enough back that the band is taut with your arms overhead.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width and lean back about 10-15 degrees.
execution: Pull your shoulder blades down.
Drive your elbows down and toward your hips until your hands reach upper-chest level.
Squeeze your lats for 1 s.
Return in 3 s to a full overhead stretch.
instructions.cues: Elbows to hips. Think of your hands as hooks.
instructions.mistakes: Leaning back to row the weight, shrugging, cutting the top stretch short.
instructions.progress: Step back, stack tubes, or go single-arm with one handle.

setup: Door anchor at the lowest point of the door, with the tube and two handles (or the Pilates bar).
Sit on the floor facing the door with legs extended and knees soft, far enough back that the band is taut.
Sit tall with arms extended.
execution: Pull the handles to your lower ribs, elbows at about 45 degrees from your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for 1 s.
Return in 3 s to full arm extension, keeping your back flat.
instructions.mistakes: Rounding the back, leaning back to cheat, shrugging.
instructions.progress: Stack tubes, or sit farther back.

setup: Stand on the middle of a heavy loop band (35-95 or 50-145) with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the top of the loop with both hands, palms facing in.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is at about 45 degrees, with a flat back and soft knees.
execution: Pull the band toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s to full arm extension.
instructions.cues: Your torso stays still. Elbows to the back pockets.
instructions.mistakes: Standing up during the rep, rounding the lower back, jerking with the hips.
instructions.progress: Widen your stance or grip lower on the loop for more tension; move to the next loop.

setup: Door anchor at the top of the door, with the tube (30 lb) and two handles.
Face the door, step back until taut, and hinge slightly at the hips (about 20 degrees).
Hold the handles in front of you at about head height, arms straight with a slight elbow bend.
execution: Sweep both arms down in a wide arc until your hands reach your thighs.
Squeeze your lats hard for 1 s.
Return in 3 s.
instructions.cues: Keep the elbow angle fixed the whole time.
instructions.mistakes: Bending the elbows (this turns it into a triceps pushdown), swinging from the hips.

setup: Door anchor at chest height, with the tube and two handles.
Face the door, hold the handles with arms straight in front of you at chest height, and step back until taut.
execution: Open your arms out to the sides in a horizontal arc until your hands are in line with your shoulders.
Squeeze your shoulder blades and rear delts for 1 s.
Return in 3 s.
instructions.cues: Lead with your elbows and keep a slight bend in them.
instructions.mistakes: Shrugging, using your torso for momentum.

setup: Clip the tube(s) to the Pilates bar and stand on the middle of the tube(s), feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the bar palms up with hands about 15 cm apart, elbows at your sides.
execution: Curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s to full arm extension.
instructions.cues: Elbows pinned to your ribs. Only your forearms move.
instructions.mistakes: Swinging the torso, elbows drifting forward.
instructions.progress: Add or stack a tube, or stand with feet wider.

setup: Stand on the middle of the tube with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold one handle in each hand with palms facing each other, elbows at your sides.
execution: Curl both hands toward your shoulders without rotating your wrists.
Squeeze for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s.
instructions.mistakes: Swinging, elbows drifting forward.
instructions.progress: Choke up on the tube, stand wider, or use a heavier tube.

setup: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent.
Wrap a loop band (25-75 or 35-95) across your upper back, under your shoulder blades.
Hold each side of the band at chest level, elbows at about 45 degrees from your torso.
execution: Press your hands straight up until your arms are fully extended (the band is hardest here).
Squeeze your chest for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s until your upper arms lightly touch the floor.
instructions.cues: Keep your shoulder blades pinched and flat on the floor. Push the ceiling away.
instructions.mistakes: The band slipping up to your neck (keep it across the shoulder blades), flaring the elbows to 90 degrees, bouncing off the floor.
instructions.progress: Heavier loop, double loop, or add a 2 s pause at the top.

setup: Door anchor at chest height, with the tube and two handles.
Face away from the door, hold the handles together at chest level with palms facing each other, and step forward into a staggered stance until taut.
execution: Press the handles straight forward, keeping them pressed together the whole way.
Squeeze your chest for 1 s at full extension.
Return in 3 s with the handles still touching.
instructions.cues: Squeeze the handles into each other as if crushing a ball.
instructions.mistakes: Letting the handles drift apart, rounding the shoulders at the end.
instructions.progress: Step farther forward, or stack tubes.

setup: Stand on the middle of the tube (40 lb) with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handles at shoulder height, palms facing forward, elbows slightly in front of your body.
execution: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your ribs stay down.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are nearly locked out.
Hold for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s back to shoulder height.
instructions.cues: Move your head slightly forward at the top.
instructions.mistakes: Arching the lower back, pressing the band out in front.
instructions.progress: Choke up on the tube, stack tubes, or go single-arm.

setup: Stand on the middle of the tube (30 lb), feet together or slightly apart.
Hold the handles at your sides, palms facing in, slight elbow bend.
execution: Raise both arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows, until they reach shoulder height.
Hold for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s.
instructions.cues: Imagine pouring water out of a jug at the top. Don't swing.
instructions.mistakes: Shrugging, raising above shoulder height, using momentum.
instructions.progress: Stand with feet wider, choke up, or stack tubes. Finish the last set with partial reps in the top half.

setup: Door anchor at the top of the door, with the tube and the handles (or the Pilates bar).
Face the door with elbows at your sides, bent to about 90 degrees.
execution: Pin your elbows to your ribs.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for 1 s.
Return in 3 s to elbows at about 90 degrees.
instructions.mistakes: Elbows drifting forward or flaring, leaning over the band.

setup: Stand on one end of a loop band (15-50) with your front foot and hold the other end behind your head with both hands.
Elbows point forward, upper arms close to your ears.
execution: Extend your arms straight up.
Squeeze your triceps for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s until your hands are behind your head.
instructions.mistakes: Elbows flaring out, arching the lower back.
instructions.progress: Next loop up, or go single-arm.

lateral-raise.name: Lateral raise
lateral-raise.targets: side delts (the main driver of shoulder width)

setup: Stand on the middle of a loop band (5-30, then 15-50) with feet together or slightly apart.
Hold the band at your sides, palms facing in, slight elbow bend.
execution: Raise both arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows, until they reach shoulder height.
Hold for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s.
instructions.cues: Imagine pouring water out of a jug at the top. Don't swing.
instructions.mistakes: Shrugging, momentum from the torso, raising above shoulder height.
instructions.progress: Next loop up, stand wider, or finish the last set with partial reps in the top half.

setup: Stand on the middle of the tube (30 lb) with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees, back flat, arms hanging with a slight elbow bend.
execution: Raise both arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows, until they reach shoulder height.
Squeeze your rear delts for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s.
instructions.cues: Spread your arms apart rather than lifting them.
instructions.mistakes: Standing up during the rep, shrugging, pulling with the hands.
instructions.progress: Choke up on the tube or stack tubes.

setup: Stand on the middle of a loop band (25-75) with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the top of the loop with hands about shoulder-width apart, arms down.
execution: Pull your hands up along your body toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height. Don't go higher.
Hold for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s.
instructions.cues: Elbows stay higher than your wrists. Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears.
instructions.mistakes: Pulling the elbows above shoulder height (this can irritate the shoulder), using a very narrow grip, shrugging.
instructions.progress: Next loop up, or widen your stance.

setup: Door anchor at the top of the door, with the tube and the Pilates bar (or two handles).
Kneel or stand facing the door, hands palms up about shoulder-width apart, arms overhead and the band taut.
execution: Pull the bar down to your upper chest, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your lats and biceps for 1 s.
Return in 3 s to a full stretch.
instructions.mistakes: Leaning too far back, shrugging.

setup: Door anchor at the top of the door, with the tube and two handles.
Face away from the door in a staggered stance, hinge slightly at the hips, with arms out to your sides slightly above shoulder height and a slight elbow bend.
execution: Sweep both hands down and across in an arc until they meet in front of your hips or lower chest.
Squeeze your chest for 1 s.
Return in 3 s with your elbow bend unchanged.
instructions.cues: Hug a big tree downward. Keep your elbow bend constant.
instructions.mistakes: Pressing instead of sweeping, shrugging, standing up straight.

setup: Clip the tube(s) to the Pilates bar and stand on the middle of the tube(s).
Grip the bar palms up, slightly wider than shoulder width, elbows at your sides.
execution: Curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Squeeze for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s.
instructions.mistakes: Swinging, elbows drifting forward.

setup: Door anchor at about shoulder height, with the tube and one handle.
Stand side-on to the door, working arm extended out to the side at shoulder height, palm up, band taut.
execution: Curl the handle toward your head, keeping your upper arm at shoulder height.
Squeeze your biceps for 1 s.
Return in 3 s to a straight arm.
instructions.mistakes: Dropping the elbow, shrugging.

setup: Stand on one end of a loop band (15-50) and hold the other end with both hands, palms up, elbows at your sides.
execution: Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Squeeze for 1 s.
Lower in 3 s.
instructions.progress: Drop this if you are running past 60 minutes.
